# XOR_Meta_Residual

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A residual learning mechanism that uses exclusive-OR (XOR) operations to combine meta-residual connections in deep spiking neural networks, enabling efficient gradient flow and feature reuse. This addresses the vanishing gradient problem in deep SNNs, which is critical for scaling iNEST architectures to deeper, more complex neuromorphic tasks.
